verified_behavior: Only fixed registered task names can request profile context; each task has a small explicit dotted-path allowlist and an optional request denylist can only narrow that grant.
Facts and reusable answers are returned only when verified, user-approved, sufficiently confident and sourced; unapproved facts fail closed.

Container requests return bounded type/count/identifier or key previews, never child values. Each text value is limited to 4000 characters and the full context to 32000 characters; oversize requests fail instead of silently truncating.

Accepted operation audit rows record operation ID, task, immutable profile version, requested approved paths and accessed fact/answer IDs, but never profile values. Denial audit rows omit requested paths and values.
Separate profile IDs remain isolated. Durable audit rows survive reopening the SQLite store.
limitations: No AI provider, prompt builder or AI task execution path exists in the current repository. The context projection is testable but cannot yet be wired to or exercised by a real task prompt. Issue #384 acceptance criterion 4 remains unchecked and the GitHub issue must remain OPEN.
The service is an internal backend interface, not a user-facing UI. Browser testing of this interface is not applicable; the full existing browser suite ran after frontend build.
PostgreSQL/Docker and hosted verification were NOT_RUN under the local-only policy. No provider or paid AI call was made; external submission stayed OFF.
Original MJ-REQ-171, MJ-REQ-175 and MJ-REQ-180 results and the original denominator remain unchanged. Full release acceptance remains PARTIAL.
